name: Mon Puchi
source: You're a genius magician that lives in an out of the way town making medicine and leisurely studying magic. One day an adventure comes to visit you. "I want you to look after them for a while." They say, and leave a half elf child in your care.
translation: 你是一位天才魔法师，住在一个偏僻的小镇，一边制造医药，一边悠闲地学习魔法。有一天，一场冒险来拜访你。“我想让你照顾他们一段时间。”他们说，留下一个半精灵孩子由你照顾。
